verdict.rationale: Data export applies to a search engine and vector database like Orama, but the evidence pack documents no export, dump, or persistence feature and no open data format. The closest items are API compatibility for migrating between Orama Cloud and Orama Open Source, on-prem deployment, and the open-source license. These are adjacent openness traits, not a documented way to export all data and leave.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
